full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiffs-appellants-petitioners is that Syed Habibullah (now dead) proposed to sell the suit property for Taka 2,500/- to Abdur Razzak the predecessor-in-interest of the petitioners and executed a deed of agreement dated 2.7.65 and received taka 500/-in cash. It was stipulated that he would remove his thatched but from the contracted land and register the sale deed within 3 months on receipt of the balance consideration of taka 2000/-. Thereafter the said vendor did not register the said sale deed nor handed over possession of the suit land as agreed upon, over the above received from the purchaser Abdur Razzak balance consideration money in (eight) installments on various dates. The vendor Syed Habibullah also paid Taka 114/- to the purchaser for bringing patta. On 1.5.1968 the vendor refused to register the sale deed and hence the present suit was filed with a prayer for specific performance of contract and for getting possession of the suit land with compensation.
